stage1_frozen_production_model.selection_basis: Sole qualifying challenger under preregistered PLAN.md Section 2.2 rule (improved 2-seed mean AP, ROC-AUC, proper Brier, proper LogLoss, and heuristic composite S_v3 across seeds 42 and 1042 on the 300 Stage1_Train rows, plus 7/10 paired outer-fold wins on S_v3, LogLoss, and Brier).
stage1_frozen_production_model.selection_bias_disclaimer: Selected from 25 configurations (C00 reference + 24 challengers) evaluated on Stage1_Train (300 rows); carries finite-sample selection bias and does not guarantee out-of-sample generalization gain.
stage1_frozen_production_model.quantum_features: Top-6 Fidelity KernelPCA components + 10 Pauli Z_i and Z_i Z_j expectation values (16 features total, standardized fold-locally and scaled by w_q=0.35)

stage2_frozen_production_solver.solver: 10-Qubit Number-Conserving Bärtschi–Eidenbenz Dicke State + Guarded RZ / DiagonalGate + Five-Chord XY-QAOA (p=3, ring_plus_5chords)
stage2_frozen_production_solver.dicke_state_preparation: Deterministic Bärtschi–Eidenbenz SCS circuit for |D_4^10> followed by X^{otimes 10} complement to prepare |D_6^10> (246 transpiled CX gates, depth 640, fidelity 1.0 vs 1,013 CX / depth 4,845 for generic StatePreparation)
stage2_frozen_production_solver.cost_separator_dispatch: O(N log N) feasibility guard checks sum(6 largest contact_costs) <= C=25 and sum(6 largest capacity_units) <= H=22. Dispatches 1-qubit prod_i RZ(gamma_l * v_i) (0 CX per layer) when proved feasible and noiseless; falls back to exact 10-qubit positive-part penalty DiagonalGate whenever constraints can bind or noise is active.
stage2_frozen_production_solver.mixer_topology: ring_plus_5chords (15 RXX+RYY pairs per layer: 10 ring edges + 5 opposite-vertex chords; 426 total transpiled CX, depth 741, expected energy -13.1573, optimal shot probability 6.75%)
